title: Root demotes to UNJOINED on newer version DIO
description: When a root receives a DIO with a newer version from the same DODAG, _adopt_version() is called which sets role=UNJOINED (line 231). A DODAG root is the authoritative version source per RFC 6550 and must never demote itself. This could cause network collapse if a reflected DIO reaches the root.
close_reason: Fixed: Root now ignores all received DIOs. Previously, a root receiving a DIO with a newer version would call _adopt_version() which set role=UNJOINED, violating RFC 6550 (root is the version authority). Added SECURITY comment explaining the rationale.
